messages:
tasha: quick flag  quantized reranker (quantA_v3) shows a reproducible MRR drop on long_queries cohort (seq len > 200). ndcg@10 barely changes but top1 collapses. anyone seen attention/kernel length issues with quant builds?
ben: numbers?
tasha: fp16 -> MRR 0.362 NDCG@10 0.623; quantA_v3 -> MRR 0.305 NDCG@10 0.619. top1 share down ~9 pts.
raj: interesting. if ndcg stable but top1 down, maybe later tokens in long context are underweighted by attention due to quant numeric range. any per-token score drift?
claire: ran a position-wise score delta: mean attention-weighted representation dot with query at token positions 1..n shows growing negative bias after token 120 in quant. looks like KV-cache accumulation precision loss.
ml-audit-bot: artifact: https://ci.redwood/evals/3170000000/quantA_v3-longseq (per-pos CSV + plots).
ben: can you try a quick runtime hack: multiply attention logits by 1.01 for tokens after 100 (attention_scale fix) and rerun a 1k mini-cohort? if MRR recovers it's numeric precision related.
tasha: doing that now (mini 1k). command: `python -m eval.run --cohort long_queries --model quantA_v3 --attention_patch="pos>100:scale=1.01" --seed 7`
(12m)
tasha: mini results: quantA_v3 patched -> MRR 0.353 (nearly recovered), ndcg 0.622. baseline quantA_v3 was 0.307 on same sample.
raj: that strongly implicates quant kernel precision loss in KV accumulation for long contexts. patch idea: change accumulation to fp32 for KV caches or add compensated summation. Perf hit but correct.
claire: short-term mitigation: block quantA_v3 for long-context onboarding lanes and add a stratified eval that measures MRR by position buckets (<=64, 65-128, 129-256, >256). Also add a CI smoke that fails if long-context MRR delta > 3%.
ben: long-term: kernel patch to preserve accumulation precision + microbench to measure perf regression. if perf hit unacceptable, explore hybrid: fp32 accumulate only for keys beyond a threshold.
tasha: action items:
- (tasha) block quantA_v3 promotion on long-context cohorts + post mini-results to ticket
- (ben) open kernel PR for compensated KV accumulation + perf tests
- (raj) add stratified eval + CI threshold for long-context MRR parity
- (claire) instrument per-position attention diagnostics in eval artifacts by default
ml-audit-bot: created issue https://tracker.redwood/ML-3310 (quant KV accumulation precision)
tasha: thanks team. putting this as a blocker for long-context onboarding until kernel fix or safe mitigation lands. :white_check_mark:
